get.description: Retrieves a list of all available server SKUs.

post.description: Creates a virtual machine group with the specified name in the given tenant id.
post.summary: Create a new virtual machine group

get.description: Retrieves a specific virtual machine group by name from the specified tenant id.

delete.description: Deletes a virtual machine group by name from the specified tenant id.

post.description: Creates a virtual machine with the specified name in the given tenant id.

requestBody.description: Virtual machine to create (image optional - defaults to ubuntu-24.04-lts)

get.description: Retrieves a specific virtual machine by name from the specified tenant id.

delete.description: Deletes a virtual machine by name from the specified tenant id.

patch.description: Applies tag mutations to a specific virtual machine by name.

post.description: Creates a block volume with the specified parameters.

get.description: Retrieves a specific block volume by name.

delete.description: Requests deletion of a block volume by name.

patch.description: Replaces the tags on a block volume.

post.description: Attaches a volume to a virtual machine.
post.summary: Attach a volume to a virtual machine

delete.description: Detaches a volume from a virtual machine.
delete.summary: Detach a volume from a virtual machine

post.description: Requests a resize of a block volume to the given size.
Creates a VPC with the specified name and CIDR in the given tenant id.

get.description: Retrieves a specific VPC by name from the specified tenant id.

delete.description: Deletes a VPC by name from the specified tenant id.

patch.description: Applies tag mutations to a specific VPC by name.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all subnets belonging to the specified VPC.

post.description: Creates a new subnet in the specified VPC with CIDR and type validation.
post.summary: Create a subnet in a VPC

delete.description: Deletes a subnet by name from the specified VPC.
delete.summary: Delete a subnet from a VPC

patch.description: Applies a partial update to a subnet. Tag entries add new tags, update existing ones, and delete tags when value is null.

cidr.description: CIDR is the IP address range for the subnet in CIDR notation

lastError.description: LastError holds the most recent error message, if the subnet is in the error state

name.description: Name is the unique identifier for the subnet

status.description: Status indicates the current state of the subnet

tags.description: Tags are optional customer tags stored as Kubernetes annotations.

tenantID.description: TenantID is the unique identifier for the tenant

type.description: Type indicates whether this is a public or private subnet

vpcID.description: VPCID is the ID of the parent VPC
